sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Four unique Triton Amulets originally belonged to the famous Alexander the Great, who used them to guard the underwater ruins of the legendary Lighthouse of Alexandria in Egypt. Their presence beneath the waves inspired the historical legend of four massive sea juggernauts protecting the structure. After Alexander's death, all four amulets remained sealed deep beneath the ocean floor. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Many centuries later, the Huntik Team discovered the hidden chamber housing the artifacts. By solving a series of ancient riddles, Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert, and Dante Vale successfully recovered the first three Triton amulets respectively. However, Captain Caine of the Organization managed to seize the fourth Amulet. 

Lok and Sophie invoked their newly acquired Tritons for an underwater battle against Caine, who summoned his own Triton along with Megladeath. Dante subsequently gave his unused Triton Amulet to Zhalia Moon, as only Seekers physically carrying a Triton Amulet could safely pass through Alexander's magical energy barrier back to the surface. When Caine returned to the surface, he gave his Triton Amulet to Gregor, having completed his mission to obtain it. However, Dante, having escaped by using Metagolem to shatter the force field, used Farslip to take the Amulet from Gregor, ensuring that the Organization left empty-handed. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Lok later summoned his Triton to battle the Organization on the Island of Sinbad, using its aquatic skills to disrupt the boat of Captain Caine and his Suits. [HM07]

sections.heading: Variants
sections.wikitext:
[[File:HM4 Lok and Sophie's Tritons.jpg|thumb|The '''second (left)''' and '''first (right)''' Tritons, summoned by Lok and Sophie respectively]]
While all Tritons share a baseline merman physiology and carry tridents, each of the four Titans has a unique appearance with an individualized color scheme:
* '''The First Triton:''' Features a sharp, red hair plume, heavy golden armor plates embossed with red gems, and a deep-sea slate-blue tail. This variant was recovered by [[Sophie Casterwill]].

* '''The Second Triton:''' Features a bright yellow/gold hair plume flowing from its helmet, pale yellow armor plates embossed with light blue gems, and a glowing, light aquamarine tail. This variant was recovered by [[Lok Lambert]].

* '''The Third Triton:''' The third of the Amulets, this variant was never explicitly invoked or shown on-panel. Based on the established pattern, it likely possessed its own unique armor trim and plume color. This variant was recovered by [[Dante Vale]] and given to [[Zhalia Moon]].

* '''The Fourth Triton:''' This variant features the most distinct appearance of the four, drastically differing from its counterparts to reflect its sinister nature: it lacks a hair plume entirely, instead wearing a heavy, dark-grey spiked helmet, silver cross-hatched chainmail over swamp-green skin, and a murky chartreuse tail. This version was recovered and used by [[Captain Caine]]. He then delivered it to [[Gregor]] before it was taken from him by Dante Vale.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Triton is based on [[wikipedia:Triton_(mythology)|Triton]], the mythological messenger god of the sea and son of Poseidon. While classical myth eventually evolved the concept into a vast, nameless race of mermen called *Tritones*, the ''Huntik'' comic adaptation uniquely fixed their number to a specific set of four distinct guardians.
* The four different versions are all referred to straight as "Triton", including in its ''[[Huntik Magazine]]'' fact file, confirming that they are all versions of the same Titan and share the same name.

Triton is a rare, aquatic Krono-Titan that resembles a heavily armored merman. Unlike other Titans that look completely identical across multiple invocations, Triton is unique in that each of the four known Amulets contains an individualised, alternate version of the Titan, including a much darker, corrupted fourth variant. 

== History ==
Four unique Triton Amulets originally belonged to the famous Alexander the Great, who used them to guard the underwater ruins of the legendary Lighthouse of Alexandria in Egypt. Their presence beneath the waves inspired the historical legend of four massive sea juggernauts protecting the structure. After Alexander's death, all four amulets remained sealed deep beneath the ocean floor. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Many centuries later, the Huntik Team discovered the hidden chamber housing the artifacts. By solving a series of ancient riddles, Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert, and Dante Vale successfully recovered the first three Triton amulets respectively. However, Captain Caine of the Organization managed to seize the fourth Amulet. 

Lok and Sophie invoked their newly acquired Tritons for an underwater battle against Caine, who summoned his own Triton along with Megladeath. Dante subsequently gave his unused Triton Amulet to Zhalia Moon, as only Seekers physically carrying a Triton Amulet could safely pass through Alexander's magical energy barrier back to the surface. When Caine returned to the surface, he gave his Triton Amulet to Gregor, having completed his mission to obtain it. However, Dante, having escaped by using Metagolem to shatter the force field, used Farslip to take the Amulet from Gregor, ensuring that the Organization left empty-handed. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Lok later summoned his Triton to battle the Organization on the Island of Sinbad, using its aquatic skills to disrupt the boat of Captain Caine and his Suits. [HM07]

== Variants ==

While all Tritons share a baseline merman physiology and carry tridents, each of the four Titans has a unique appearance with an individualized color scheme:
* The First Triton: Features a sharp, red hair plume, heavy golden armor plates embossed with red gems, and a deep-sea slate-blue tail. This variant was recovered by Sophie Casterwill.

* The Second Triton: Features a bright yellow/gold hair plume flowing from its helmet, pale yellow armor plates embossed with light blue gems, and a glowing, light aquamarine tail. This variant was recovered by Lok Lambert.

* The Third Triton: The third of the Amulets, this variant was never explicitly invoked or shown on-panel. Based on the established pattern, it likely possessed its own unique armor trim and plume color. This variant was recovered by Dante Vale and given to Zhalia Moon.

* The Fourth Triton: This variant features the most distinct appearance of the four, drastically differing from its counterparts to reflect its sinister nature: it lacks a hair plume entirely, instead wearing a heavy, dark-grey spiked helmet, silver cross-hatched chainmail over swamp-green skin, and a murky chartreuse tail. This version was recovered and used by Captain Caine. He then delivered it to Gregor before it was taken from him by Dante Vale. 

== Abilities ==
The Tritons are apex underwater combatants and powerful swimmers. They are highly specialized for deep-sea tracking and heavy aquatic warfare. Each warrior is armed with a magically-infused trident fixed to its right arm, which is used for both piercing attacks and parrying close-range strikes. When invoked together, multiple Tritons can coordinate their movements to form a synchronized defensive front against gargantuan threats.
